name: Imizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Imizu city emblem in navy: a disc pierced by two white curved strokes, like a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Imizu, a city in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2005.

features.role: Imizu city emblem — a disc pierced by two white curved strokes, like a stylised swirl
